extracted.intended_audience: small biotechnology companies/small businesses preparing SBIR/STTR applications to NIH/NIAID (Phase I/II applicants and proposal preparers)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and documenting an NIH/NIAID SBIR Phase I grant application (PHS 398/SBIR forms) for a diagnostic development project, including budget, personnel, research plan (Specific Aims, Research Strategy), milestones, validation criteria, and SBIR-specific administrative questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim 1 milestone: optimized reagents and LoD
rubrics_metrics.description: Optimized PANDAA primers/probes and buffer with limit of detection (LoD) <10 RNA cps/reaction for LASV strain Josiah.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Months 0-6. Draw on experience and optimized workflows to develop PANDAA-LASV primers and probes against a novel target in highly conserved regions, plus a custom reaction buffer. Reagent sensitivity will be analyzed on LASV reference sequences and empirically optimized. Milestone wording: 'Optimized PANDAA primers/probes and buffer with limit of detection (LoD) <10 RNA cps/reaction for LASV strain Josiah.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim 2 milestone: pan-lineage sensitivity normalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Refined PANDAA-LASV assay with LoD <10 RNA cps/reaction and sensitivity deviation <25% between lineages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Months 6-9. Evaluate reagents on divergent LASV templates encompassing all circulating lineages. Use iterative designs incorporating pre-established molecular techniques (e.g., PANDAA ProAmp and/or universal bases) to normalize sensitivity across lineages. Milestone wording: 'Refined PANDAA-LASV assay for which LoD <10 RNA cps/reaction and sensitivity deviation <25% between lineages.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim 3 prototype performance specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Prototype PANDAA-LASV assay must demonstrate (a) pan-lineage 95% detection limit of <10 RNA cps/rxn, (b) negative signal from non-LASV templates (Cq >37 cycles), and (c) clinical sensitivity >95%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Months 9-12. Milestone wording: 'Prototype PANDAA-LASV assay with the following specifications: pan-lineage 95% detection limit of <10 RNA cps/rxn, negative signal from non-LASV templates (Cq >37 cycles), and clinical sensitivity >95%.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Analytical and clinical validation procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a pan-lineage analytical validation panel and probit analysis to determine 95% detection limit; perform serial dilutions of spiked serum to quantify LoD; evaluate specificity with LASV-negative human serum, related arenaviruses, and other pathogens causing febrile illness; quantify clinical sensitivity with diverse-lineage LASV clinical isolates obtained via partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly states validation methods: 'A pan-lineage analytical validation panel and probit analysis will be used to determine 95% detection limit. Serial dilutions of spiked serum will quantify LoD for purified samples. Specificity evaluation will be carried out with LASV-negative human serum, related arenaviruses, and other pathogens that cause febrile illness. Clinical sensitivity will be quantified with diverse-lineage LASV clinical isolates obtained via partnerships with FIND/BNI.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan components (PHS 398 required sections)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Plan must include specified PHS 398 sections: Introduction (for resubmission/revision), Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List, Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Letters of Support, Resource Sharing Plan(s), Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources, Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Files for many sections must be attached (example file names shown). Follow PHS 398 instructions and include each listed subsection: 'Specific_Aims_LASV_final.pdf', 'Research_Strategy_LASV.pdf', 'Select_Agents_LASV_final.pdf', 'LoS_all_fixed_margins_LASV_final.pdf', 'Authentication_of_Key_Reagents_LASV.pdf', etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Vertebrate Animals requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If vertebrate animals are involved, indicate whether animals are euthanized and whether the method is consistent with AVMA guidelines; if not consistent, describe the method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section requires explicit Yes/No answers and justification when AVMA guidelines are not followed: 'Are vertebrate animals euthanized? If "Yes" to euthanasia Is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines? If "No" to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether program income is anticipated during the periods for which grant support is requested; if yes, report budget period, anticipated amount ($), and source(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If program income is anticipated, use the specified format to reflect amount and source(s) per budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human embryonic stem cells declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells; if yes, list registration number(s) of specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry or check that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer Yes/No and provide registry numbers or check the box: 'Specific stem cell line cannot be referenced at this time. One from the registry will be used.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents disclosure (for renewals)
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether there are inventions and patents associated with the application; if yes, indicate whether they were previously reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section labeled 'Inventions and Patents: If the answer is "Yes" then please answer the following: Previously Reported: Yes/No.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Institution reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a change of Project Director/Principal Investigator or change of grantee institution has occurred, provide the name of the former PD/PI and former institution and complete required fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete identifying information for former PD/PI or institution as prompted by the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment listing threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: List each equipment item and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section C requires: 'List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.' Total equipment requested must be reported and attachments for additional equipment allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget justification attachment constraint
rubrics_metrics.description: Only one Budget Justification file may be attached.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form text: 'Budget_Justification_LASV_final.pdf (Only attach one file.)' Ensure the single file contains all necessary justification detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget categories and required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete budget sections A-K: Senior/Key Person, Other Personnel, Equipment, Travel, Participant/Trainee Support, Other Direct Costs (materials, publication, consultants, ADP/Computer, subawards, rentals, alterations), Direct Costs, Indirect Costs (rate, base), Total Direct/Indirect Costs, Fee, Total Costs and Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide requested values for salaries, months, fringe, funds requested, indirect cost rate and base, and attach supporting budget justification and files as required. The form includes specific line items and totals to be completed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel descriptions and effort reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: For each Senior/Key Person and Other Personnel, provide name, project role, calendar/academic/summer months, percent effort, salary, fringe benefits, and role-specific responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide biographical and effort details in the Biosketches and Budget Justification; include 'Role: Lead Scientist', effort (e.g., 'Year 1 – 1.2 calendar months'), and narrative of responsibilities. Distinguish 'Other Significant Contributor' with no measurable effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research associate qualification and duties
rubrics_metrics.description: TBD Research Associate should be Ph.D. or M.S. + 2 years industry experience and will be responsible for executing R&D experiments, primer testing, probe sensitivity comparison, design evaluation, buffer optimization, and analytical sensitivity/specificity efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary duties include thorough record-keeping and communication of results to the R&D team; the research associate will be closely managed by Lead Scientist and supervised by PI to meet Phase I milestones.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fringe rate composition disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: State and describe the fringe rate and what it includes (e.g., PTO, payroll-associated taxes, workers' compensation, unemployment compensation, limited life insurance, employer contributions to medical and dental insurance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form text provides an example: 'Fringe rate: Aldatu’s fringe rate for the duration of this Phase I SBIR is [value], which includes: paid time off (PTO), all payroll-associated taxes, workers’ compensation, unemployment compensation, limited life insurance, and employer contributions to medical and dental insurance.'

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR applicant certification and eligibility questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must answer mandatory SBIR/STTR administrative questions: small business eligibility at time of award; anticipated number of personnel at award; majority ownership by VC/hedge/private equity; faculty- or student-owned status; subcontracts with Federal labs; HUBZone status; whether all R&D will be performed in the United States; disclosure of duplicate/essentially equivalent proposals or awards; disclosure permission statement for title/contact release; and whether required Commercialization Plan is included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Questions 1a-7 must be completed by all SBIR/STTR applicants. For example: '1a. Do you certify that at the time of award your organization will meet the eligibility criteria for a small business as defined in the funding opportunity announcement?' and '4. Will all research and development on the project be performed in its entirety in the United States? If no, provide explanation in an attached file.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercialization Plan requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain application types require a Commercialization Plan: Phase I (DOE only), Phase II (all agencies), Phase I/II Fast-Track (all agencies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form states: 'The following applications require a Commercialization Plan: Phase I (DOE only), Phase II (all agencies), Phase I/II Fast-Track (all agencies). Include a Commercialization Plan in accordance with the agency announcement and/or agency-specific instructions.' Attach file if required.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR-specific prior award disclosure (questions 8-9)
rubrics_metrics.description: SBIR applicants must disclose whether the company has received SBIR Phase II awards and provide a company commercialization history if yes; must indicate whether the PD/PI will have primary employment with the small business at the time of award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Question examples: '8. Have you received SBIR Phase II awards from the Federal Government? If yes, provide a company commercialization history...' and '9. Will the Project Director/Principal Investigator have his/her primary employment with the small business at the time of award?'

rubrics_metrics.name: STTR-specific participation and effort requirements (questions 10-12)
rubrics_metrics.description: For STTR applications: (1) PD/PI must have a formal appointment or commitment with the small business or research institution and devote at least 10% effort; (2) the small business must perform at least 40% of the work and the research institution at least 30% of the work in joint R&D; (3) provide DUNS number of non-profit research partner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Questions 10-12 specify these STTR constraints and require Yes/No answers and supporting information where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercialization history reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: If the applicant has received Phase II SBIR awards in the preceding five years, list prior Phase II awards and provide dates, grant numbers, titles, and PI names (company commercialization history).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example entries shown: R44AI118441 (06/01/15–05/31/18) title and PI, R44AI128974 (01/17/17–12/31/19), etc. Also statement: 'Aldatu Biosciences has not received more than 15 SBIR Phase II awards from the Federal Government during the preceding five fiscal years.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Diagnostic long-term deployment/impact criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: Long-term goal that the diagnostic be deployable in endemic regions on existing qPCR equipment and/or integrated into point-of-care systems to reduce the testing algorithm from two tests to one and improve outbreak response and management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposal-level expectation: successful development and validation should precede a clinical diagnostic product deployable in endemic regions and potentially integrated into closed point-of-care systems to improve Lassa fever diagnostic workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assay innovation and comparative performance expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed PANDAA approach should demonstrate superiority in cross-lineage sensitivity and mitigation of target-proximal polymorphisms compared to current gold-standard assays (e.g., outperforming current assays by greater than an order of magnitude in cross-lineage sensitivity in preliminary studies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Innovation claims must be supported by preliminary feasibility data; proposal cites prior analytical and clinical validation in HIV and preliminary LASV template data showing detection of multiple lineages with near equal sensitivity and superior cross-lineage sensitivity.
